card: Adds functional test coverage for compact block messages that arrive more than two blocks ahead of the chain tip. Previously, neither the full-block retry request path nor the fallback header-processing path (fRevertToHeaderProcessing) had test coverage, allowing either branch in net_processing to be broken without CI failing. Issue #34618 identified the missing coverage for peer eviction protection, and earlier discussions in PR #34722 identified the missing retry coverage.
evidence: Issue #34618 reported missing test coverage for fRevertToHeaderProcessing in compact block handling.

PR description demonstrates failure modes: disabling the getdata retry branch causes block requests to stall until peer timeout, while disabling fRevertToHeaderProcessing drops outbound peer eviction protection.
problem: P2P logic handling compact blocks received far ahead of the active chain tip lacked test coverage. Both the full-block getdata retry branch and the fRevertToHeaderProcessing branch could be disabled or deleted without causing CI test failures.

risk.why: Touches only functional test code without modifying consensus or production P2P message handling.

summary: Adds functional test coverage for compact blocks received more than two blocks ahead of the node's tip. It tests that the node requests the full block via getdata if it had already requested the block from that peer, and verifies that high-bandwidth outbound peers announcing such blocks are protected from eviction via the header-processing fallback path.
